Hi Sam — quick technical answers and a sample payload. High-level:

- Where logs live: we persist admin activity logs and API logs into an append-only object store backed by immutable block storage (WORM) for customers that opt-in; by default logs are tamper-resistant with RBAC and immutable retention policies. Customers can request WORM-style immutability for regulated workloads.
- Export formats: we support newline-delimited JSON and CSV exports via our admin console or API. Exports include schema versioning metadata.
- Retention: configurable per-tenant retention windows (30/90/365/730 days); we also support long-term archival exports to customer S3 or via secure transfer.

Sample audit event (newline-delimited JSON):
{"timestamp":"2027-05-03T14:58:12Z", "actor":"user:admin@acme.com", "action":"model.deploy", "resource":"models/retail-reco-v2", "request_id":"req-9f8a7b6c", "severity":"info"}

I’ve uploaded a short technical note to the shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeAuditLogs) with field descriptions and examples. Happy to add more fields if your ingestion team needs them.

- Regarding tamper-evidence: we can enable signed manifests and an optional append-only ledger hash chain for audit logs; this is an add-on (low-lift for our infra team) if your compliance team requires cryptographic tamper evidence.

Let me know which retention window you need and whether you want exports to S3.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
